title: Uplifting Smoky Polish Beef Skewers
description: A hearty, low-sodium Polish dish featuring tender beef, robust smoked paprika, and tangy orange juice, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the beef into thin strips and season with garlic powder, black pepper, and salt.
Soak the wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the beef, onion, bell pepper, and potato onto the skewers.
Place the skewers on the grill and brush with sunflower oil.
Grill for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the smoked paprika and orange juice in a small bowl.
After 5 minutes of grilling, brush the skewers with the smoked paprika mixture.
Continue grilling for another 3-5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
Garnish with fresh dill, if desired.
